# health

Whether the service is up.

## GET /v1/health

Operation `health_view`.

Liveness check. Returns service status and version string.

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [HealthResponse](schemas.md#healthresponse)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
